storeId.description: Stable id for the collaborative feature store (maps to PostGIS table jgis_store_<slug>).

tileUrlTemplate.description: MVT URL template with {z}/{x}/{y} for the live tipg baseline (usually jupytergis_core/tiles/collections/…). Prefixed with the Jupyter base URL at runtime. Append ?v= from baselineVersion for cache busting.

pmtilesPath.description: Legacy path/URL to a static PMTiles baseline (unused when tileUrlTemplate is set).

baselineVersion.description: Monotonic baseline version; bump after each fold and append as ?v= on tile requests.

projection.description: CRS for feature coordinates (lon/lat stored as EPSG:4326).

attribution.description: Attribution for the collaborative point source.
